name: com.veilbreak.ar-hud
description: UI Toolkit framework for game UI: a PanelRenderer host and view that own screens, modals, toasts and keyboard/gamepad focus; boards (HudStage) with visor chrome; the cut-shape kit, press feedback and effects; themes, effects profiles and a live editor workshop.

samples.description: Editable UXML and a bound telemetry driver. Use Veilbreak > AR HUD > Create Demo in Scene for an instant gallery.
